extend.name: Extend
extend.description: Moves the off time by minutes. Negative values shorten it; if nothing is left, the entity is switched off now. Without a timer an entity that is on counts from now, one that is off is switched on for the minutes.

entity_id.description: The managed entity, e.g. the fan itself.

minutes.description: Minutes to add, negative to shorten.
